_r=_B.strip().split("\n"); _c=_r[0].split(); B62={}
for _l in _r[1:]:
    p=_l.split()
    for cc,v in zip(_c,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],cc)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-1)
def align(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]; srow=np.array([sc(a,b) for b in s2],float)
        Mp,Xp,Yp=M[i-1],Ix[i-1],Iy[i-1]
        st=np.vstack([Mp[:-1],Xp[:-1],Yp[:-1]]); best=st.max(0); wh=st.argmax(0)
        v=best+srow; neg=v<0; M[i,1:]=np.where(neg,0,v); pM[i,1:]=np.where(neg,3,wh)
        xo=np.vstack([Mp[1:]+go,Xp[1:]+ge,Yp[1:]+go]); Ix[i,1:]=xo.max(0); pX[i,1:]=xo.argmax(0)
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o=(M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge); Iy[i,j]=max(o); pY[i,j]=int(np.argmax(o))
    i,j=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(M),M.shape); i,j=int(i),int(j)
    state=0;A=[];Bv=[];mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if state==0:
            if M[i,j]<=0: break
            A.append(s1[i-1]);Bv.append(s2[j-1]);mp[i]=j
            s_=int(pM[i,j])
            if s_==3: break
            state=s_;i-=1;j-=1
        elif state==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bv.append('-');state=int(pX[i,j]);i-=1
        else: A.append('-');Bv.append(s2[j-1]);state=int(pY[i,j]);j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bv)),mp,float(M.max())

PANEL=[("Set6 (Sc)","Q12529","test"),("Set5 (Sc)","P38890","active, PMID 22343720"),
 ("SMYD3 (Hs)","Q9H7B4","active"),("SMYD2 (Hs)","Q9NRG4","active"),("SMYD1 (Hs)","Q8NB12","active"),
 ("SMYD5 (Hs)","Q6GMV2","uncertain"),("SUV39H1 (Hs)","O43463","active"),("DIM-5 (Nc)","Q8X225","active"),
 ("SETD7 (Hs)","Q8WTS6","active"),("Set1 (Sc)","P38827","active"),("Set2 (Sc)","P46995","active"),
 ("SETD2 (Hs)","Q9BYW2","active"),("Set3 (Sc)","P36124","INACTIVE"),("Set4 (Sc)","P42948","INACTIVE"),
 ("MLL5/KMT2E (Hs)","Q8IZD2","INACTIVE"),("SETD5 (Hs)","Q9C0A6","INACTIVE")]
S={n:"".join(get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta").text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for n,a,_ in PANEL}
SMYD3=S["SMYD3 (Hs)"]
REF={205:'NHxC\nAsn',206:'NHxC\nHis',208:'SET-C\nZn Cys',239:'catalytic\nTyr',259:'SAM\nPhe',
     261:'post-SET\nZn C1',263:'post-SET\nZn C2',266:'post-SET\nZn C3'}
cols=[f"{SMYD3[p-1]}{p}" for p in REF]
data=[];labels=[];sws=[];cls=[]
for n,a,c in PANEL:
    s=S[n]; a1,a2,mp,sw=align(s,SMYD3[191:280]); inv={v+191:k for k,v in mp.items()}
    row=[]
    for p in REF:
        q=inv.get(p); row.append(s[q-1] if q else '.')
    data.append(row); labels.append(f"{n}  [{c}]"); sws.append(round(sw)); cls.append(c)
D=pd.DataFrame(data,columns=cols,index=labels); D.insert(0,"SW",sws)
print("=== Catalytic-column scoring anchored on SMYD3 SET-C/post-SET (PDB 3MEK) ===")
print(D.to_string())
print("\nSet5 vs Set6 full-length SW:",align(S["Set5 (Sc)"],S["Set6 (Sc)"])[3])

print("  aligned len %d, identity %.1f%%"%(len(a1),100*sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y and x!='-')/len(a1)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,7))
m=np.array([[1.0 if D.iloc[i][c]==c[0] else (1.0 if (c.startswith('Y') and D.iloc[i][c] in 'YF') else
            (0.45 if D.iloc[i][c]!='.' else 0.0)) for c in cols] for i in range(len(D))])

ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{c}\n{REF[int(c[1:])]}" for c in cols],fontsize=8)

        ax.text(j,i,D.iloc[i][c],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,fontweight='bold',
                color='black' if m[i,j]>0.3 else 'white')
    ax.text(len(cols)-0.35,i,f"  SW={D.iloc[i]['SW']}",fontsize=7.5,va='center',ha='left')
for i,l in enumerate(D.index):
